description: This file serves as an index or barrel file, exporting various modules and types related to cryptographic runtime functionality within the Matrix project. It consolidates exports for bootstrapper, facade, decrypt bridge, IDB persistence functions, verification manager, and verification status utilities, facilitating import convenience for other parts of the project.

classes.name: MatrixDecryptBridge
classes.description: Represents the decrypt bridge component responsible for decryption operations within the cryptographic runtime.

classes.name: MatrixVerificationManager
classes.description: Manages verification processes, overseeing device verification statuses and summaries.

methods.name: persistIdbToDisk
methods.description: Persists IndexedDB data to disk for storage or backup.

methods.name: restoreIdbFromDisk
methods.description: Restores IndexedDB data from disk to recover state.

methods.name: isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified
methods.description: Checks whether the Matrix device owner is verified.
